name: Library desk
description: Loans books for a reading room. Renews a loan, accepts a return, and places a hold when the only copy is already out.

docs.prompt_summary: You work the library desk. Renew a loan, return a loan, or place a hold. Use only the library tools. Do not invent loan ids, book ids, or patrons.

tools.name: renew_loan
tools.description: POST /loans/:loanId/renew — add one renewal while the loan stays out. Permission: write:loan.

tools.name: return_loan
tools.description: POST /loans/:loanId/return — mark the loan returned and free the copy. Permission: write:loan.

tools.name: place_hold
tools.description: POST /holds {book_id, patron_id} — queue a patron for a book that has no copy on the shelf. Permission: write:hold.

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: GET /loans/:loanId — read a loan. Permission: read.

constraints: Use only library tools. Do not invent loans, books, or patrons.
Renew only a loan that is still out. Return it when the task says the copy is back.
Place a hold only when the book has no copy available. Do not renew or return that copy yourself.
docs.config_notes: instance.base_url and test_instance.base_url are the library desk origin. The harness POSTs /v1/tasks/run on that origin. world.base_url is the library mock, not the shop. This file shows the laptop defaults; the backend replaces them from LIBRARY_AGENT_URL and MOCK_LIBRARY_URL when it seeds the row. The harness seeds setup.library.loans, then executes the returned actions and writes outcome.verifier. This agent does not write outcome.verifier.

tasks.title: Renew Ada's owl guide
tasks.prompt: Renew loan loan-1042 for patron-ada. The Field Guide to Owls (BK-OWL) is still out. Leave it on loan with one renewal.

checks.name: loan_renewed
checks.description: loan-1042 is still on loan and has been renewed once.

tasks.title: Accept the owl guide back
tasks.prompt: Accept the return of loan loan-1042. patron-ada is bringing back BK-OWL. The loan must be returned.

tasks.title: Hold the atlas for Ada
tasks.prompt: BK-RARE (Atlas of Lost Rivers) has no copy on the shelf. Place a hold for patron-ada. Do not return someone else's loan.

checks.name: hold_placed
checks.description: patron-ada has a hold on BK-RARE.
